Privacy

Drafts and champion pools are saved in your browser. The companion reads champion select locally and sends champion IDs and role hints directly to this page. League credentials and player identities stay off the website.

Draft Lab uses Google Analytics to measure website visits. Google receives ordinary usage information such as browser/device information and may use analytics cookies. Our page tracking excludes URL queries, connection tokens, draft picks, pools, and searches. Enhanced measurement, Google signals, and advertising personalization are disabled for this setup. A browser Global Privacy Control signal skips Analytics.

Read how Google uses information from sites that use its services.
